description.account: An account stores your username, your email address, the time it was created and the time you last signed in. The username is also the publicly visible display name. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR; the data is required to provide the account.
description.changes: This policy is adjusted when the application or the legal situation changes. The version published here is the one that applies.
description.complaint: Regardless of this, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the member state of your residence, your place of work or the place of the alleged infringement.
description.contact-mail: When you write to us, for example to exercise your rights, we process your address, the content of your message and the connection data the mail server records in doing so, in order to answer your request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR where your account is concerned, otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR, the legitimate interest being to answer enquiries. The correspondence is deleted once the matter is settled and no retention obligation stands in the way.
description.content: Inside the application you store content yourself: collections with holdings, condition, language, finish, location and the purchase prices you record, decks with their cards, folders and tags, watch lists and the statistics derived from them. This data is tied to your account and is processed solely to provide the application's functions. For deck advisor suggestions, the cards of the deck in question are sent to another service on the same infrastructure. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.
description.external-links: The application links to third-party offerings such as Cardmarket, Scryfall or deck platforms. Data is transmitted to those providers only once you follow such a link; their privacy policies then apply.
description.hosting: The application runs on the servers of a hosting provider located in Germany. A processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR is in place with that provider. When you open the application, the web server processes technically necessary connection data: IP address, date and time, requested address, status code, amount of data transferred and the identifier reported by your browser. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR, the legitimate interest being secure and reliable operation. These logs are deleted after {{logDays}} days.
description.import: When you import a deck from another site, the server fetches the address you provided and reads the card list published there. The request comes from the server rather than from your browser, so your IP address is not disclosed to the other provider. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.
description.liability: The content of these pages was created with care, but no guarantee is given for its accuracy or completeness. The operators of linked external sites are solely responsible for their content. No infringements were apparent when the links were set; links will be removed once an infringement becomes known.
description.local-storage: The application stores data in your browser (localStorage, IndexedDB and the cache of the installable app). It holds your display settings such as colour scheme, view and collapsed sections, the username you last used, scans you have not filed yet, and a cache of card data so the application stays usable on a poor connection. This data does not leave your device and is not read by us. You can delete it at any time through your browser's settings.
description.obligation: Providing a username and an email address is required for an account; without them no account can be created and the application can only be used in its public parts. There is no statutory or contractual obligation to provide them.
description.passkeys: Signing in works with passkeys (WebAuthn) only; no passwords are used or stored. We store your passkey's public key information, its identifier, a signature counter and a name for the device. The private key and any biometric characteristics stay on your device and are never transmitted. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.
description.privacy-intro: This policy describes which personal data is processed when you use this application, for which purpose and on which legal basis.
description.publishing: You can make profiles, decks and collections public or share them through a share link. Public content is available to anyone together with your username and may be indexed by search engines. A share link can be opened by anyone who knows it, without an account. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR, given by publishing the content or creating the link. You can withdraw it at any time by making the content private again or revoking the link; content that has already been copied cannot be recalled that way.
description.registration-mail: When an account is created and when you add another device, a single-use registration link is sent to the email address you provided. The link is valid for {{registrationDays}} days. It is sent through a self-operated mail server on the infrastructure named above; the recipient address, the content of the message and the mail server's logs are processed in doing so. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.
description.retention: Account data and your content are stored for as long as your account exists. You can delete your account yourself in the account settings; this deletes your account, your passkeys, your collections, decks, watch lists and share links. In the running system the deletion takes effect immediately. In addition, write-protected snapshots of the database are kept which cannot be altered individually after the fact; data still contained in them ceases to exist with the respective snapshot after {{backupDays}} days. These snapshots are accessed solely to restore the service after a fault; should already deleted data be restored in the process, it is deleted again. Server logs are deleted after {{logDays}} days. The mail server's logs record sender and recipient address, time, remote host and delivery status; they are limited to a fixed size and are pushed out by newer entries. Data we are legally required to retain is kept until the respective period expires.
description.rights: You have the right to obtain information about the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR), to rectification (Art. 16), to erasure (Art. 17), to restriction of processing (Art. 18) and to data portability (Art. 20). Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7 (3) GDPR). You may object to processing based on a legitimate interest under Art. 21 GDPR. Please use the address given above.
description.scanner: The card scanner accesses the camera only after you allow it in your browser. Recognition runs entirely on your device: camera images are neither transmitted nor stored on the server. Only the result is transmitted, that is the card you add to your collection.
description.scryfall: Card images, card data and search results are loaded directly from Scryfall (Scryfall LLC, USA) by your browser. Scryfall thereby receives your IP address, your browser identifier and the request itself, including your search terms. This transfer to the USA is required to display the cards; the legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR, the legitimate interest being the display of current and complete card data without copying the image data ourselves.
description.session: After you sign in, a technically necessary session cookie is set so the server can assign requests to your account. The cookie holds no content data and is not used to analyse your behaviour. Storing it requires no consent under § 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG, as it is strictly necessary for the function you asked for. The session ends when you sign out.
description.telemetry: For diagnostics and monitoring, the services record technical information about requests, among them the time, the duration, the function called and error messages. These records are collected on our own infrastructure only and are not passed on to third parties. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
description.trademarks: Magic: The Gathering is a registered trademark of Wizards of the Coast LLC. This project is not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast and is neither operated, endorsed nor reviewed by them. Card text and card images come from Scryfall. Prices are based on the publicly published price guide of Cardmarket, a service of Sammelkartenmarkt GmbH & Co. KG, and on the market prices quoted by Scryfall. They are fetched automatically on a schedule, serve as non-binding guidance and do not constitute an offer.
